title: MongoDB Cloud - Admin Admin API: Intermittent Increase in 5xx errors
text:
Service: MongoDB Cloud
Incident: Admin Admin API: Intermittent Increase in 5xx errors
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-10-09T13:11:12.242Z
Resolved: 2026-10-09T15:46:16.628Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-09T15:46:16.628Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-09T14:43:16.110Z: monitoring - We have deployed a mitigation for the elevated HTTP 500 errors affecting the MongoDB Atlas Admin API. We are seeing signs of recovery and are monitoring the service to confirm the issue does not recur before resolving this incident.
- 2026-10-09T13:11:12.446Z: investigating - We are seeing elevated HTTP 500 errors affecting the MongoDB Atlas Admin API. Users may experience intermittent failures when making API calls. We are investigating the root cause and will share another update as our investigation continues.
